title: Molten vault: six variations (607 D1b)
desc: J on 607 D1b: "this one is a keeper, i need more variation". Six takes keeping D1b's glass vault, pillars, drips and core, each changing one big thing. Also fixes "at a certain angle the lantern is transparent" (the gold now stays solid from every angle).

takes.name: Molten: heavy pour
takes.facts: twice the drips, thicker, gold pooling on the base steps; 1,241 boxes

takes.name: Molten: hex
takes.facts: six panels and six fluted pillars, drips between them; 2,146 boxes

takes.name: Molten: tall
takes.facts: taller, narrower vault, two-tier roof with a spiked crown, longer drips; 1,024 boxes

takes.name: Molten: overflowing bowl
takes.facts: a glowing bowl crown overflows: streams run over the lip, down the roof and off the eaves; 1,380 boxes

takes.name: Molten: caged
takes.facts: an outer cage of gold bars a pixel off the glass, drips caught on the bars, double knuckled handle; 1,143 boxes

takes.name: Molten: squat
takes.facts: lower, broader vault, deep dripping eaves, a tall stepped roof, four short feet; 1,188 boxes
